name: GradientBlinds-TS-TW
title: Gradient Blinds
description: A full-screen field of soft diagonal gradient stripes in pink, violet and blue, with a bright spotlight that follows the pointer and a fine film-grain noise over the top.
use: You want a colourful, graphic backdrop that still reads as abstract light, for a hero or event page.
avoid: The bright stripes are high-contrast and busy, so text needs a scrim, and it never stops animating.
a11y: The grain and spotlight animate forever and ignore reduced-motion; the canvas has no label. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Parallel diagonal stripes on black, each a soft-edged band that fades from dark to bright, running pink through violet to cyan-blue across the group. A round white spotlight brightens one area, and a fine grain textures the surface.
behaves: The spotlight glides toward the pointer with a little damping, brightening whichever stripes it covers. A gentle noise flickers over the surface, and the gradient can be angled, mirrored or distorted.
customise: Props set gradient colours, angle, noise, blind count and minimum width, mouse dampening, mirroring, spotlight radius, softness and opacity, distortion, shine direction and blend mode.
weight: heavy: A full-screen WebGL shader with grain noise redraws on every frame.
